ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all beneficial owners, directors, and authorized signatories against the UN Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC SDN List, UK FCDO consolidated sanctions list, EU consolidated financial sanctions database, and any domestic Vanuatu designations; foreign Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) trigger enhanced due diligence under section 10 of the Financial Transactions Reporting Act [Cap. 295], including documented source-of-wealth and source-of-funds evidence; suspicious transaction reports must be filed with the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU) in accordance with statutory timelines; registered agent must maintain CDD files for not less than 5 years after termination of the business relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Companies Registry — International Companies Division, Port Vila; online lodgement via the VFSC portal (www.vfsc.vu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Proposed names must be submitted in English or French using Latin (Roman) script; transliteration of non-Latin-script names is permitted only where a Romanized adoption is formally filed with the Registrar; every International Company name must end with 'Limited' or 'Ltd.' in accordance with section 6 of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]; names that include territorial, sovereign, regulated, or aviation-related tokens require prior written consent of the VFSC and, where applicable, the Vanuatu Civil Aviation Authority and the responsible Ministry.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection of a proposed name, the licensed Vanuatu registered agent may file a written administrative appeal with the VFSC International Companies Division within 14 calendar days of the rejection notice, stating the legal grounds and attaching any requisite ministerial or VFSC consent; the VFSC Registrar must issue a determination within 21 working days; a further judicial review may be pursued by originating application before the Supreme Court of Vanuatu under the Judicial Review Act; a rejected name may alternatively be re-lodged with a revised distinguishing element, and a reserved name may be extended upon payment of the applicable statutory fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted for the International Company structure: under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222], the IC is prohibited from carrying on business within Vanuatu and must maintain only a registered office and registered agent located in Port Vila; for offshore air cargo charter brokerage, the VFSC accepts a virtual registered-office arrangement at the licensed agent's address, and no physical operational premises, employees, or tangible commercial substance in Vanuatu are required to preserve the tax-exempt IC status.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low — estimated 2% annual probability of an unannounced on-site inspection for a compliant passive International Company; however, the registered agent and its AML/CFT records remain subject to VFIU/VFSC supervisory inspections, so all UBO, CDD, and sanctions-screening files must be immediately accessible.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Act No. 12 of 2018 of the Republic of Vanuatu, as consolidated; in particular ss. 4-6 (incorporation by registration and application), s. 8 (company constitution), s. 11 (company name and reserved names), the registered-office and registered-agent provisions, and the share-capital provisions; together with the Companies (Forms) Regulations 2018 and the International Company designation rules administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Registrar of Companies, International Companies Registry, Port Vila, Vanuatu.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Registration of a Company (prescribed form under the Companies (Forms) Regulations 2018) accompanied by the executed Company Constitution and the registered agent's certification; submitted electronically through the VFSC registry portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: None prescribed. A Vanuatu International Company may issue shares without par value for any lawful consideration; there is no statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow or capital-deposit account requirement. Initial share capital is determined by the subscribers at their election.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
BE IT RESOLVED AS PROVIDED FOR UNDER THE COMPANIES ACT NO. 12 OF 2018:
1. The Constitution of the Company presented to this meeting is adopted and registered as the governing instrument.
2. The shares subscribed for in the Constitution are allotted fully paid to the initial shareholders, no minimum paid-up capital or escrow deposit being required.
3. The registered office is established at [Port Vila address], and [Registered Agent] is appointed as registered agent.
4. [First Director] is appointed Managing Director and [Company Secretary] is appointed Company Secretary.
5. The Directors are authorized to open US Dollar and Vatu accounts with a licensed bank for Swift Wire and Fedwire transfers and to execute all charter-brokerage agreements, waivers, and licensing applications.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management (MFEM), Port Vila; corporate and licensing registry: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) via VFSC-licensed registered agents; customs single window: ASYCUDA World (VRC Customs Division).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: 1) Incorporate an International Company (IC) under the International Companies Act [CAP 222] through a VFSC-licensed registered agent; Certificate of Incorporation is issued within approximately 24 hours. 2) The incorporation filing automatically triggers allocation of a Vanuatu Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) by VRC; no in-person interview or minimum capital is required. 3) Apply to VRC Customs Division for a Customs Business Registration (CBR) certificate to obtain an exporter code. 4) Obtain an annual Business Licence under the Business Licence Act. There is no tax file interview, no economic substance filing, and no direct tax registration obligation for an IC; the TIN and CBR are used for customs, stamp duty, and statutory returns.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone: An International Company (IC) under the International Companies Act [CAP 222] is statutorily exempt from all present and future Vanuatu taxes, including income tax, corporation tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, VAT/sales tax, and stamp duty on IC instruments, provided it does not carry on business with Vanuatu residents and does not own Vanuatu land. The entity is a separate limited-liability juridical person; although structurally an entity-level taxpayer, its statutory exemption results in an effective 0% direct tax burden.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch elections exist because Vanuatu has no income tax statute. Available statutory elections under the IC Act [CAP 222] include: (i) election to redomicile/continue a foreign company into Vanuatu as an IC; (ii) election to convert an IC into an ordinary domestic company and vice versa with VFSC approval; (iii) election to issue par-value or no-par shares and maintain multi-currency share capital; and (iv) elective appointment of directors, shareholders, and registered agent. No passthrough election exists, as the IC regime simply imposes zero direct taxation at entity level.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None in force (VAT/GST repealed 1 August 1998). Residual indirect taxes: customs import and export duties under the Customs Act [CAP 232], stamp duty under the Stamp Duties Act [CAP 74], municipal and tourism levies. There is no VAT, GST, or sales and use tax regime applicable to air cargo charter brokerage.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable: no VAT/GST exists, so no turnover threshold can trigger VAT registration. For customs indirect tax purposes, every exporter/importer must hold a Customs Business Registration (CBR) regardless of turnover; there is no de minimis threshold. Air charter brokerage service fees are outside the scope of any Vanuatu indirect tax, so no taxable-turnover threshold is triggered.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No electronic invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, digital stamping, or government API clearance mandate is in force. Export and departure formalities are processed electronically through the ASYCUDA World customs management system: electronic Export Declaration, cargo manifest, and aircraft departure clearance are lodged via the VRC single electronic window with risk-based and intelligence-led inspection. The broker must retain the customs-endorsed export entry and original supporting documents for audit.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Statutory export zero-rating is not applicable because Vanuatu does not impose VAT/GST on exports; air cargo charter brokerage services rendered to offshore clients are simply outside any Vanuatu indirect tax charge. No export duty is payable on services. For physical cargo or aircraft spares exported from Vanuatu, most goods qualify for duty-free export treatment; the exporter claims such treatment by lodging the Export Declaration through ASYCUDA World and obtaining customs endorsement. There is no VAT refund mechanism because no output tax is ever charged.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration / Export Entry lodged electronically via ASYCUDA World and endorsed by Vanuatu Customs
Air Waybill (Master and House AWB) or Bill of Lading evidencing outbound movement
Commercial Invoice and Packing List with full description and HS classification
Certificate of Origin where preferential or destination-country origin treatment is claimed
Charter Agreement or Brokerage Contract evidencing the terms of the air cargo charter transaction
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No VAT zero-rating claim or refund mechanism exists, so there is no direct VAT clawback exposure. Scrutiny focuses on customs and licensing compliance: (1) false or misleading customs declarations attract penalties under the Customs Act [CAP 232] of up to VUV 1,000,000 and/or imprisonment of up to 10 years, plus forfeiture of goods; (2) an IC that transacts with Vanuatu residents, engages in prohibited business, or acquires Vanuatu land breaches the International Companies Act [CAP 222], exposing the company to strike-off and retrospective loss of its statutory tax exemption; (3) unstamped agreements are inadmissible as evidence and attract penalty interest under the Stamp Duties Act [CAP 74]; (4) failure to renew the CBR or Business Licence results in suspension of export privileges and administrative fines; and (5) breaches of the VFSC anti-money laundering regime applicable to brokers can trigger additional regulatory penalties. No statutory foreign-exchange repatriation deadline applies because Vanuatu has no exchange control legislation.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) - monetary authority and exchange-control administrator under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [Cap 125] and the Exchange Control Act [Cap 103]; AML/CFT supervision is shared with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) and the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) under the Financial Transactions Reporting Act 2002.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vatu (VUV) is a partially convertible currency. Current-account payments incident to the air-cargo charter brokerage (charter hire, fuel, ground handling, dispatch fees, broker commissions) are liberalized under the RBV standing General Permission and may be settled through licensed banks against documentary evidence (charter contracts, invoices, air waybills, IATA settlement statements). Capital-account transactions - non-resident share subscriptions into a Vanuatu International Company - are permitted in VUV or foreign currency, but borrowing in VUV by external enterprises and on-lending to Vanuatu residents require RBV specific approval. Profit remittances are not subject to statutory withholding, exchange surcharge, or mandatory conversion; the practical hurdle is the FATF increased-monitoring (grey-list) regime, which triggers enhanced due diligence, beneficial-ownership verification, and robust source-of-funds documentation for every outward credit.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu imposes no mandatory surrender of export proceeds, no statutory conversion ratio, and no forced repatriation timeline. A VU International Company acting as the invoicing and clearing principal for air-cargo charter service exports may retain 100% of foreign-currency earnings in an RBV-licensed foreign-currency account. Conversion into VUV for local operating expenses occurs on the interbank market at the prevailing rate. All export-service receipts must be supported by underlying files (signed charter party/ACMI agreements, commercial invoices, master air waybills or house air waybills, and CASS settlement records) for the bank's documentary archive and for periodic balance-of-payments/statistical reporting to the RBV.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Multi-Currency Operational Account and USD Escrow/Retention Account
USD Foreign-Currency Operational Account and Capital Deposit Account
Domestic VUV Operational Account only; limited cross-border USD clearing capacity

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW as the primary treasury rail; MEDIUM only as an ancillary collection/disbursement channel capped at 5% of monthly flows. Vanuatu has no PSD2-style e-money directive, no cross-border EMI passporting regime, and offshore digital EMIs cannot carry on business in or from Vanuatu without a VFSC financial-dealer licence under the Financial Dealers Licensing Act [Cap 248]; such licences are operationally difficult to obtain for speculative fintech issuers. In addition, an International Company licensed under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] is prohibited from offering financial-dealer services to Vanuatu residents. The IC should therefore use only an FCA- or EU-authorised EMI with segregated client funds, a direct SWIFT gateway, and an approved-name client relationship, while directing at least 95% of inbound and outbound value through RBV-licensed banks or top-50 global correspondent banks.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: MANDATE: EFFECTIVELY MANDATORY. All RBV-licensed banks classify the air-cargo charter brokerage IC as Enhanced Due Diligence (Medium-Risk Enhanced) and require (i) the ultimate beneficial owner and at least one director or authorized signatory to attend an in-person KYC interview at the Port Vila branch or at the bank's recognised overseas affiliate (ANZ/BSP international desk) under a bank-to-bank introduction; and (ii) delivery of certified English-language corporate records: Certificate of Incorporation, Memorandum and Articles of Association, VFSC Certificate of Good Standing, directors and UBO register extracts, registered-agent appointment letter, and the current beneficial-ownership filing receipt. Remote video opening is not categorically forbidden but is practically rare: a remote protocol may be accepted only for non-signatory directors, with the UBO's physical attendance remaining mandatory given the FATF grey-list exposure.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Vanuatu FATF grey-list residual status: elevated country risk rating and unpredictable US/EU correspondent-bank scrutiny of Vanuatu-sourced transactions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current VFSC Certificate of Good Standing; VFSC beneficial-ownership filing confirmation; licensed-agent appointment letter; group organizational chart; written AML/CTF policy of the IC; letter of explanation confirming that the IC is a non-resident offshore vehicle with all trade operations conducted outside Vanuatu, and that economic substance is evidenced by a physically serviced Port Vila back-office and the licensed registered agent.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Asset-light agency/commission model with large third-party disbursements for charter hire, ground handling, and fuel, creating round-tripping or trade-based money-laundering risk.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Contracts portfolio: signed charter party/ACMI agreements with aircraft operators; commercial invoice register; master air waybills and cargo manifests; IATA CASS settlement statements; counterparty KYC pack including the aircraft operator's AOC/FAA Part 121 or EASA equivalent; client org charts; and a monthly reconciliation ledger demonstrating that each disbursement is matched to an identified underlying cargo transaction.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore shareholder or UBO located in a tax-secrecy or underbanked jurisdiction with no prior Vanuatu banking relationship.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: UBO passport and proof-of-address (apostilled); prime-bank reference via SWIFT MT199/MT799; source-of-wealth declaration with independent documentation (audited financial statements, share sale agreements, real-estate registry extracts); source-of-funds evidence covering the capital injection; and a written explanation of the UBO's management role within the corporate group, supported by directorships and title certificates.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High expected clearing velocity with escrow-like float behaviour disproportionate to the available invoicing evidence.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: 12-month treasury cash-flow budget; client-by-creditor mapping table; written policy requiring that every outbound payment be matched to an inbound receipt or an original commercial contract; prohibition of third-party pay-away transfers absent original documentation; and an independent audit trail of the treasury ledger.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unlicensed or minimally regulated fintech/EMI counterparties appearing as fund sources or disbursement destinations.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board resolution adopting an Approved Financial Counterparty List comprising only RBV-licensed banks, top-50 global banks, and FCA/EU-authorised EMIs with segregated client funds; treasury policy capping EMI flows at 5% of monthly value; copies of each EMI's licence and passporting confirmation; and bank statements evidencing that the primary clearing route is the RBV-licensed settlement bank.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route the capital injection by SWIFT MT103 (customer credit transfer) from the UBO's prime bank to the IC's USD foreign-currency account at ANZ or BSP Port Vila. In field 50K/70 use the exact wording: Capital contribution - subscription for ordinary shares in [IC legal name]; in field 59 state the IC's full legal name and VFSC registry number. The bank will map the credit to its direct-investment/equity statistical code for RBV balance-of-payments reporting. Supporting pack to be delivered pre-wire: board resolution authorising the allotment, signed share certificates, updated beneficial-ownership register entry in the VFSC portal (filed within 14 days), and source-of-funds evidence. For amounts above the bank's in-house threshold (commonly USD 250,000 or USD 1,000,000), pre-notify the compliance officer with an MT199 bank reference and PDF copy of the capital certificate so the credit is cleared before release. VUV-denominated injections are lawful but operationally exceptional; the IC should invoice capital in USD to avoid VUV conversion liquidity friction.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary rail: SWIFT MT103 for charter hire, fuel, ground handling, navigation, dispatch, and brokerage fee disbursements, each matched to an approved invoice and the controlling charter reference. The Vanuatu settlement bank clears USD through its nostro/correspondent network (major US clearing banks such as JPMorgan Chase or Citi) using Fedwire for same-day value. Secondary rail: Commercial Letter of Credit (SWIFT MT700) is available where an aircraft owner or fuel supplier requires documentary payment against presentation of a commercial draft, invoice, certificate of airworthiness, and cargo documents; issue limits are governed by the bank's credit appetite. A Standby Letter of Credit (SWIFT MT760) may be demanded for security deposits under ACMI or charter performance obligations; it is treated as a contingent liability and triggers standard credit underwriting. For repetitive high-value disbursements, establish creditor standing orders with a unique charter-agreement number in field 70 so the bank can auto-match payments to the approved disbursement schedule under straight-through processing.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable vanilla FX forwards USD/AUD and USD/EUR with tenor up to 6 months, extendable to 12 months for prime corporate clients, executed under the Vanuatu bank's FX Master Agreement or ISDA 2002 framework

Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing VUV for ancillary local-currency liquidity exposure, available from global banks maintaining a thin VUV book; practical only for notional amounts up to USD 1,000,000 per month

Cross-currency swaps (USD/AUD and USD/EUR) with tenor up to 12 months, permitted for the non-resident International Company where both counterparties are external to Vanuatu, executed through the bank's offshore book and confirmed under ISDA
Window forward contracts structured as a forward series for variable charter-billing dates, a standard Vanuatu bank product for recurring disbursement cycles
OTC currency options (USD put / AUD call) for capex-grade or long-term charter commitments, quoted on a request-only basis and subject to board treasury policy and ISDA collateral arrangements

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return of the International Company under Section 109, International Companies Act (Cap. 222)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 calendar days after the anniversary of incorporation (anniversary-based, not calendar-year based)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty imposed by VFSC; loss of good standing; default notice published; cumulative default leads to administrative strike-off under s.117 of the IC Act with assets vesting in the Government

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Confirmation of Ultimate Beneficial Ownership under the Companies and Limited Partnerships (Beneficial Ownership) Amendment Act 2019
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC - Beneficial Ownership Registry (through licensed registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual confirmation aligned to the incorporation anniversary; any change in beneficial ownership lodged with VFSC within 14 days of the change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Statutory offence with fines; inability to obtain Certificate of Good Standing; adverse AML supervisory action against the company and registered agent

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory audit for Vanuatu International Companies; no revenue, asset, or headcount threshold triggers a mandatory external audit; financial statements are not required to be lodged with VFSC
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutory IFRS mandate; IC Act requires books and records that disclose financial position with reasonable accuracy and permit preparation of true and fair statements; simplified internal or Local GAAP accounting is acceptable

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: International Company must collect and maintain beneficial ownership data, file UBO particulars at incorporation, and confirm annually through its licensed registered agent; the UBO register is held at the registered office and must be produced to VFSC on request for shareholding transfers exceeding statutory thresholds

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not required by law; voluntary review or audit for due diligence purposes USD 1,500 - 4,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: International Companies (ICs) incorporated under the International Companies Act Cap 222 are absolutely exempt from income tax, capital gains tax, and stamp duty; no corporate income tax, payroll tax, or social security levy applies to ICs. No tax holiday election is required because the zero-rate exemption is automatic and non-discretionary. Value added tax (VAT) applies only to domestic supplies within Vanuatu and does not attach to offshore air cargo charter brokerage income. Loss relief and carryforward are irrelevant in the absence of a taxable base.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No Vanuatu corporate income tax return exists for International Companies. The sole periodic compliance filing is the VFSC Annual Renewal, submitted electronically through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) online e-registration portal by the licensed registered agent on behalf of the IC.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The renewal and prescribed annual government fee come due on the anniversary of incorporation (or at incorporation for the first year); the statutory calendar is unrelated to any corporate fiscal year-end because the IC is outside the income tax filing universe.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Renewal Field 1 - Company Legal Name and CR Number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact IC name and registration number as recorded in the VFSC Companies Register.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must match the certificate of incorporation; foreign-language transliterations are not permissible as the legal name.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Renewal Field 2 - Registered Agent and Registered Office Confirmation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identification of the Vanuatu-licensed registered agent and the registered office address in Port Vila.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered agent is the authorized filer; non-resident directors and shareholders do not file directly and may not use a non-Vanuatu address.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Renewal Field 3 - Directors, Members, and Beneficial Ownership Register Confirmation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation that the registers of directors and shareholders are current and held at the registered office.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Beneficial ownership information is kept privately with the agent; bearer shares are prohibited and UBO details must be disclosed to the agent for AML/CFT purposes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Renewal Field 4 - Compliance and Non-Resident Trading Declaration
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of compliance with the International Companies Act, including confirmation that no business is conducted within Vanuatu unless separately licensed.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Air cargo charter brokerage must be conducted entirely offshore; any physical office, local employees, or domestic invoicing would require a Business Licence and could erode the exempt status.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Renewal Field 5 - Prescribed Annual Fee Remittance
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Payment of the VFSC annual government fee calculated on the IC's authorized share capital bracket.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Fees are payable in US dollars by wire transfer to the VFSC; the agent should obtain a receipt and updated certificate of good standing for the company record book.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late renewal triggers a statutory late penalty (approximately 25% of the annual fee) and continued non-payment leads to administrative strike-off from the VFSC register. A struck-off IC loses legal capacity and its assets may vest in the Registrar; restoration fees and accruing default penalties are payable before reinstatement. The VFSC may also refer repeated non-compliance to the Tax Information Authority for exchange-of-information assessment.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - Vanuatu imposes no dividend withholding tax; dividends distributed by an IC to non-resident shareholders are free of all Vanuatu tax and there are no exchange control restrictions on repatriating USD dividends by Swift or Fedwire.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has not concluded any comprehensive double taxation agreement (DTA), so conventional treaty rate relief and tax-sparing are unavailable. To evidence tax status to foreign payors or banks, the IC should obtain, through its registered agent, a VFSC Certificate of Good Standing and/or a tax status confirmation letter from the Vanuatu Department of Finance and Treasury or the Tax Information Authority. Because no DTA exists, a foreign withholding reduction can be obtained only under the foreign payor's domestic law; if a mutual agreement procedure is available under a specific Vanuatu tax information exchange agreement (TIEA) competent-authority mechanism, the request must be submitted in writing to the Vanuatu Tax Information Authority. Inbound dividends remain taxable to the recipient as determined by the shareholder's own residence jurisdiction.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory Vanuatu withholding rate on outbound interest and IP royalties: 0% (no domestic WHT mechanism applies to ICs). Treaty rates: N/A due to the absence of DTAs. A charter broker paying interest or royalties to foreign lenders or licensors will be subject to the source country's WHT if the lender or licensor is resident there; the IC must obtain WHT savings clauses or gross-up protection in its commercial contracts.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: None - Vanuatu has no transfer pricing statute, no arm's length codification, and no Local File or Master File monetary thresholds in vatu (VUV) applicable to ICs. The only documentation discipline is the economic substance record-keeping obligation: readily available books, contracts, bank statements, and operational evidence must be produced to the VFSC or Tax Information Authority on request.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicable. Vanuatu's 2021 economic substance reforms to the International Companies Act and the accompanying Economic Substance Regulations require ICs engaged in a relevant activity to submit an annual Economic Substance Declaration through the VFSC. Relevant activities include banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, financing and leasing, headquarters, holding company, intellectual property, and distribution and service centres. An air cargo charter broker would be in scope if it provides services to foreign connected enterprises (distribution and service centre) or acts as the group's headquarters; a purely third-party brokering vehicle is likely outside the core categories but must nevertheless file the declaration to confirm non-applicability. In-scope ICs must show a physical office in Vanuatu, adequate local employees, proportionate local operating expenditure, and management and control exercised in Vanuatu; failure results in financial penalties, deregistration, and automatic information exchange to foreign tax authorities.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Vanuatu IC as a booking shell for air cargo charter transactions while the real management, contracting, and risk decisions occur in a high-tax jurisdiction, or issuing false representation letters claiming foreign tax residence to reduce shippers' withholding liabilities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The foreign jurisdiction may recharacterize income, deny treaty benefits, apply CFC or GAAR rules, and sanction the IC under anti-avoidance legislation; Vanuatu authorities may strike off the IC for false declarations and report the matter through exchange-of-information channels.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners face civil liability for restitution of unpaid taxes, restriction orders, travel bans during investigation, and imprisonment where conduct amounts to fraudulent trading or perjury.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deriving service or brokerage income from a foreign connected airline group without any office, employees, or management in Vanuatu, and filing a false Economic Substance Declaration that no relevant activity exists.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Escalating financial penalties per relevant activity, daily default fines, deregistration from the VFSC register, and exchange of filed substance information with treaty partners under the applicable TIEA.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are jointly liable for unpaid penalties; in severe cases the VFSC may obtain a court disqualification order, an asset freeze, and a travel ban pending restoration or liquidation.
